main_text.p: ΚΑΙ ΤΑ ΧΡΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΧΕΙΝ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΦΘΑΝΟΝΤΟΣ[?].

page.notes: The scan is very blurred and low in contrast, so almost all Latin lines cannot be read and are marked illegible. The clearest line is the last Greek line, "ΚΑΙ ΤΑ ΧΡΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΧΕΙΝ ΤΟΥ ΑΠΟΦΘΑΝΟΝΤΟΣ", where the final word is doubtful. The Greek line just above it ("ΝΑΙ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΝ ...") and the other Greek lines higher up (e.g. "ΜΟΣΧΟΥ...", "ΤΟΥ ΑΡ...", "ΝΑΙ") are too faint to copy and are omitted. The short letters at the left edge (D, L, T and others) may be marginal letters or line beginnings; they are too faint to confirm. No running head, page number or catchword can be read. A higher-resolution or better-contrast scan would allow a full transcription.
